title: Airwallex product universe
description: A graphite band: a centred white headline and line, then a pill tab bar whose active tab fills with the product's saturated gradient. Each tab opens a panel with a caps eyebrow, a big medium-weight statement, an outline video pill and a tall phone shot on the left, and a bento of three rounded graphite cards (one wide, two square-ish) on the right. Hovering a card grows its arrow into a Learn more label. On phones the tabs become an accordion of pills; the open one shows its cards in a sideways swipe row.
notes: always dark: the section carries `dark`, so it reads the theme's dark colours on a light page
needs JavaScript to switch tabs (hydrate: visible); the static HTML shows the first tab
three cards per tab fill the bento: the first is the wide one
